<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Inflation breach:</strong> India&#x27;s retail inflation rose to 4.38% in June, exceeding the RBI’s 4% target for the first time in 18 months, potentially complicating the monetary policy outlook.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFBaODgwazNxbDNqYWdONFl6WnBvOUhEVmdReGdxR1ozS245dmszWXpLZUJvNWNPdk1ucmcwNmF3dW56N2tsWnQtQWFULVZLMm1oZldTeTcwTzdrUzFrb1dkSm5IR0pnajdpazJxZmJBeklfdUFXeGRhN0pvLXI?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNTzFTZHhVd3NTRHM5Ym5IZUJOd2R5bkxwLTdLekJNb19sMmxuSjhzVHhqNHd4UV93YkNHTFY3M2ZIVDduYUp0YlVUWURvQnRRZGF5MDE4b282U21LZ3pFUjlIVFozS215Njdncm8tM0lyQ1JrbjJKS1k5OGFsOE5JMTZKSHdEY0c2UVQ2eFBzTnFscGdvSWlualAzbDVkdHdkVHhfdEV4b2_SAagBQVVfeXFMTU8xU2R4VXdzU0RzOWJuSGVCTndkeW5McC03S3pCTW9fbDJsbko4c1R4ajR3eFFfd2JDR0xWNzNmSFQ3bmFKdGJVVFlEb0J0UWRheTAxOG9vNlNtS2d6RVI5SFRaM0tteTY3Z3JvLTNJckNSa24ySktZOThhbDhOSTE2Skh3RGNHNlFUNnhQc05xbHBnb0lpbmpQM2w1ZHR3ZFR4X3RFeG9v?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

  <li><strong>Currency and market pressure:</strong> The Indian rupee faces potential downward pressure toward the 96 level due to the combined impact of surging oil prices and rising US bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
